_help: Every release. The page sorts them by releaseDate, newest first, and adds filter buttons (Albums / EPs / Singles) when there is more than one type. Copy the _example block into the releases list for each release. links: fill only the platforms that exist, empty ones are hidden; the key names come from data/platforms.json. Clicking the cover opens the platform named in primary (or the first link). cover is optional; a coloured placeholder is shown until you add one. tracks is optional (useful for albums). language (optional, for example Afrikaans or English): when releases have more than one language the Music section is split into one group per language, with jump buttons. Put the order you want in a "languages" list next to "releases".
